title: SSL Certificate Checker: Expiry, Issuer, Chain, TLS
description: Check SSL/TLS certificates for any list of domains: days until expiry, issuer, whether it covers the host name, trusted chain, self-signed, TLS version, cipher, key type and all subject alternative names. Great for expiry monitoring on a schedule.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Domains or URLs (a port like example.com:8443 is allowed). Up to 20,000 per run.

warnDays.title: Warn when expiring within (days)
warnDays.description: Certificates expiring within this many days get an 'expires_soon' warning.

host.title: Certificate checked
host.description: One host's certificate read and checked. Hosts that do not exist or refuse the connection are free.

store.seoDescription: Check SSL certificates for many domains: expiry date, days left, issuer, hostname match, chain trust, TLS version. Schedule it for expiry alerts.
